review_scope: Static source/support review and independent read-only consistency checks on both actual local exports; no assembler, adapter, Lean, Git or cloud execution.
reviewed_gates: Both complete owner entries are required; both verify_owner calls finish before any publication directory, PASS summary or FILE_INDEX is written.

Original provider tasks must be succeeded/exit0 with complete output; readonly must be a distinct later task; original receipt must be REVALIDATED. Missing, queued, failed or FRESH records cannot satisfy acceptance.
Original compressed envelope, full group member set, each member SHA/bytes and corresponding local raw bytes are checked, and every exported member is retained in publication.
Fixed source/adapter/commit and exact submitted stage/export scripts bind the original readonly, operation, normal, kernel/full-owned and stage evidence.
Owned/public counts and axiom names come from original OWNED_EXPORTS and must agree with worker/audit/readonly/envelope; no GroupLog count is prefilled in the code.
Original registry stays 18/21; two new owners are separate; Policy template remains UNBOUND; Tau and bridge stay source-only; complete P1.5 remains OPEN.
Output must be fresh; all raw packet files are copied before the final PASS summary; existing publication and FILE_INDEX are not overwritten.
review_limit: This review confirms the evidence assembly path and supplied original exports. It is not a replacement mathematical acceptance validator.
